subject: HyperTransformer status: repro green, semi-supervised gains real but size-dependent
body:
Lucia, Deshawn,

Status. Supervised repro is green on all three benchmarks - omniglot essentially saturated, miniImageNet and tieredImageNet 5-way results within 0.4 pts of the released numbers, off the rebuilt Corpus caches.

Semi-supervised: adding unlabeled support samples gives us +2.3 pts on miniImageNet 5-way 1-shot with our smallest target CNN. That's the regime the release predicted - the win concentrates where the target CNN is too small for a fixed universal embedding to do the work, and the transformer modulating all generated weights actually matters.

The catch, and it's the key feasibility finding so far: at our largest target size the semi-supervised gain shrinks to +0.5 pts and supervised parity with a plain fine-tuning baseline gets close. So the product story is specifically small-model personalization, not a general few-shot win. Carmen is mapping the crossover curve (accuracy delta vs target-CNN params) for the memo - that plot will carry the July recommendation.

Vera
